name: Fracture
description: Break a regular rhythmic pattern into irregular fragments. Take a pattern and insert unexpected gaps, stutters, and displaced hits.
usefulWhen: The rhythm feels too predictable or grid-locked
repair: If the fracture makes the rhythm unintelligible, keep the kick/bass hits on their original positions and only fracture the percussion layer.
strudelHints: Use struct() to create irregular patterns
Vary pattern length: not always 16 steps

name: Ghost Notes
description: Add very quiet hits between the main accented hits. Ghost notes create a sense of continuous motion and organic flow without adding new distinct events.
usefulWhen: The rhythm feels stiff, mechanical, or too sparse between main hits
repair: High-pass filter ghost notes to keep them from muddying the low end. Keep gain below 0.1 — they should be felt, not consciously heard.
strudelHints: Layer a second copy of the pattern at .gain(0.05) with .hpf(500)

name: Density Wave
description: Gradually increase and decrease the density of rhythmic events over time. Like a tide — more hits, then fewer, then more again.
usefulWhen: Adding long-form structural movement to a loop-based pattern
repair: The wave period should be at least 8 cycles. Faster waves feel like random density changes rather than a meaningful structural gesture.
strudelHints: Add/remove percussion layers over time via layer control system

name: Swing Injection
description: Introduce swing/shuffle to a straight pattern, or remove swing from a swung pattern. Changes the entire feel of the groove without changing any notes.
usefulWhen: The groove needs a different feel — looser and more organic, or tighter and more mechanical
repair: Apply swing to specific layers, not the entire pattern. Kick and sub-bass should usually stay straight while percussion and hi-hats get the swing.
strudelHints: Delay specific hits by small amounts using .delay() with very short times
Layer swung and straight versions of the same pattern

name: Velocity Sculpting
description: Dramatically vary the gain/velocity of individual hits to create accents, ghost notes, and dynamic shape. Instead of all hits at the same level, create a hierarchy of emphasis.
usefulWhen: The pattern lacks dynamic shape — all hits feel equally important
repair: Maintain at least 20% of hits at full velocity to anchor the rhythm. The quietest hits should be at 5-10% of full.
strudelHints: Layer the same sound at different gain levels for deliberate accent patterns

name: Stochastic Variation
description: Use probability to create organic, non-repeating variation in rhythmic patterns. Each cycle is slightly different, but the overall groove identity remains.
usefulWhen: The pattern is loop-based and needs variation without structural changes
repair: Keep probability low (0.1-0.25). Apply to secondary hits, not primary kick/snare. The core identity must survive the randomness.

name: Polyrhythm Layer
description: Add a layer that plays in a different time signature or subdivision than the main pattern (e.g., 3 against 4, 5 against 4). Creates complex, shifting rhythmic relationships.
usefulWhen: The rhythm needs complexity beyond what a single grid can provide
repair: Keep the polyrhythm layer sparse and quiet — it should create texture, not confusion. The main groove must remain clearly dominant.
strudelHints: Layer a pattern at a different cycle length using .slow() or .fast()

name: Silence as Rhythm
description: Use deliberate, strategic silence — removing hits that the listener expects. The gaps become rhythmic events themselves.
usefulWhen: The pattern feels too busy or predictable — silence can be more powerful than another hit
repair: Remove hits from secondary layers first. Never remove the primary kick on beat 1 unless the concept specifically calls for disorientation.
strudelHints: Replace hits with rests in struct()
Remove entire layers for 4-8 cycle sections
